title: order-button menu config
description: The menu, shop number and options for order-button. Keys starting with _ (like _note) are allowed anywhere and ignored.

name.description: Shop name. It is the second line of the order message.

whatsapp.description: The number that receives orders: digits only, country code first, no + (India: 919800000000). Required unless ordering.previewOnly is true.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code: INR, BRL, AED, NGN, KES, ZAR, MYR, SGD, IDR, MXN, USD...

currencySymbol.description: Optional sign to show instead of the one Intl picks, e.g. ₹ or R$.

locale.description: Number format, e.g. en-IN (₹1,23,456) or pt-BR (R$ 25,90).

timezone.description: IANA time zone for the date in the order ID, e.g. Asia/Kolkata. Default: the visitor's time zone.

modes.description: Which options the customer can pick. With delivery, an address is required.

minOrder.description: Minimum item total before the order can be sent.

deliveryFee.description: Added to delivery orders and shown in the message.

deliveryNote.description: Shown under the address field, e.g. 'Delivery within 3 km'.

orderPrefix.description: Start of the order ID (LLK-0811-4821). Default: initials of the shop name.

previewOnly.description: true = show the message on screen and never open WhatsApp. For demos and testing.

payment.description: What the pay panel shows after the order is sent. order-button never takes or checks payments.

qrImage.description: URL or path of the shop's own UPI QR image (static, no amount).

intent.description: Show a 'Pay with a UPI app' (upi://pay) button on phones. Only for verified merchants: NPCI disallowed P2P intent payments from 1 April 2024.

note.description: Shown under the payment details, e.g. 'Pay after the shop confirms your order'.

labels.description: Override any text, e.g. { "checkout.send": "Enviar pedido" }. The keys are listed in the README.

id.description: Lowercase letters, digits and dashes, e.g. chicken-dum-biryani.

price.description: A number without a currency sign. With variants, the price of the size picked first.

veg.description: true = veg mark, false = non-veg mark, leave out for no mark.

tags.description: Shown as small text. Known: bestseller, spicy, new, jain, eggless, chef-special. Others are shown as written.

variants.description: Sizes or portions with their own prices (Half/Full, 500 g/1 kg).
